content.headline: Three Things to Remember Today
content.body: Using AI safely in government requires three core pillars. Miss any one, and AI becomes a liability instead of an asset.
bullets: The Right Tool — use the best AI tool for the job, not just the one you know
Full Control — learn prompts, tokens, and settings so the output stays predictable
Governance First — follow the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Rules at every step
